title: Verify shared XcodeGen schemes across all 3 Wave 1 Apple targets (macOS + iPadOS + iPhoneDuo + CI check)
summary: Follow-up to 20261126-082450_v021-apple-relay-smoke: added explicit shared schemes in apps/apple/project.yml so xcodegen always emits shared .xcscheme files for MangaStudio-iPadOS, MangaStudio-macOS-Touch, and MangaStudio-iPhoneDuo.
